title: Base Read/Write Multiple Registers variant 3
purpose: Use a stateful setup followed by a combined read/write transaction, covering both register initialization and the combined function's distinct address and payload fields.

messages.label: Setup write multiple registers at address 0010
Read/write multiple registers reading 0010 and writing 0020

expected_behavior: The endpoint may acknowledge the setup write, then process the combined transaction by reading two registers and writing two registers; unsupported functions or addresses may produce normal Modbus exceptions.
constraints_preserved: protocol identifier is 0000 in both messages
first MBAP length 000b equals unit identifier plus 10-byte write-multiple PDU
second MBAP length 000f equals unit identifier plus 14-byte read/write PDU
write byte counts match the declared two-register quantities
transaction identifiers are distinct and unit identifier 02 is consistent
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability issue knowledge is available. The sequence is a normal setup-and-operation coverage seed and does not encode an issue-specific hypothesis.
